nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system, a sequence of states $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ is a finite run of length $k$ when for every $i < k$ there is a label $a$ such that there is a transition from $s_i$ to $s_{i+1}$ labelled $a$.
nodes.title: Finite run

nodes.summary: Let $P$ be a predicate on the states of a labelled transition system such that, whenever $P(s)$ holds and there is a transition from $s$ to $t$ with some label, $P(t)$ holds. Then for every infinite run $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ with $P(s_0)$, the predicate $P(s_k)$ holds for every $k$.
nodes.title: Invariant principle for infinite runs

nodes.summary: Select a witnessing label at each step of an infinite state run.
nodes.title: Infinite state runs lift to labeled executions

nodes.summary: Forget the labels of a canonical infinite execution.
nodes.title: Labeled infinite executions give state runs

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system, a sequence of states $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ is an infinite run when for every $i$ there is a label $a$ such that there is a transition from $s_i$ to $s_{i+1}$ labelled $a$.
nodes.title: Infinite run
Shifted function sequences agree with ω-sequence drop

nodes.summary: For a sequence $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ and a natural number $k$, the shift of the sequence by $k$ is the sequence whose $i$-th term is $s_{i+k}$; that is, the suffix starting at index $k$, re-indexed from $0$.
nodes.title: Shifted sequence

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system, say that a state $s$ can reach a state $t$ when there is a finite list of labels along which $s$ makes a multistep transition to $t$. If $s$ can reach $m$ and $m$ can reach $t$, then $s$ can reach $t$.
nodes.title: Reachability in a labelled transition system is transitive

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
